These findings collectively indicate that Npc172494 may interact with Riboflavin synthase through different molecular mechanisms, possibly involving receptor activation or enzyme inhibition. The integration of these pathways highlights the complexity of the relationship, with multiple compounds potentially influencing Riboflavin synthase through distinct biological targets. The evidence supports a mechanistic link, but further validation is required to confirm the direct interaction and the specific molecular mechanism involved.
